messages.subject: Indexing: My site is not in index | https://www.eliai.cn/ | [reply-address-redacted]
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for contacting Bing Webmaster Support.
We have completed our investigation regarding this issue, and it appears that the level of indexation for your website is not related to any technical issues. Your website is being evaluated by our systems for inclusion in our search results and should be indexed within the next couple of weeks, assuming there is no violation of our Bing Webmaster Guidelines. As this website submission is super fresh, it will take some time for all the URLs to get indexed.

Additionally, some of the site's pages have not accrued sufficient ranking signals (such as links and traffic) to be selected for indexing.

When Bing crawls and indexes pages on the Internet, it makes decisions based on which pages are likely to be relevant to searchers. We evaluate these signals relative to other sites on the web as part of our selection criteria. As your pages gain popularity, more of them will be indexed.

We recommend using “IndexNow” to instantly notify Bing and other search engines about your new or updated URLs.

I wish to help you with a few links and help docs, which will not only help in avoiding blocks but also help you to rank better in the Bing index.

  • Why is My Site Not in the Index?
  • 10 SEO Myths Reviewed
  • Is SEO The Future? No, And Here’s Why
  • Building Authority & Setting Expectations
  • The Role of Content Quality in Bing Ranking


We hope the resolution provided has been able to fully address your issue. We will be closing this ticket. However, if you do have any follow up questions or concerns, please submit a feedback here.

Sincerely,
Bing Webmaster Support Team
